versionNote: 0.1.9 changes rings to VaM-style red/green/blue axis colors, removes the selected marker outline so size remains a proximity cue, and adds click-to-select for visible available atom markers through VaM's proved SelectController API.

sourceLineage.lineageNote: FA Keyboard informed camera-relative placement, render queues, transparent emissive materials, and direct Custom\Plugins deploy receipts. No keyboard source is copied into this repo.

plannedRelease.note: Product package name candidates for a future release. Current prototype deployment remains DLL-only.
